# RQ2
## Part 1
```{r}
# ── 1. Load packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggsci)
library(showtext)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
showtext_auto()

# ── 2. Read data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx", sheet = "data_cognitiveload_meta_Groupby")


wb <- createWorkbook()
write_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, df) {
  sheet_name <- substr(sheet_name, 1, 31)   
  if (!(sheet_name %in% names(wb))) {
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df)
}

# ── 3. General mixed ANOVA function ）──────────────────────────────
run_mixed_anova <- function(df, prefix, suffixes) {
  
  col_names <- paste0(prefix, "_", suffixes)
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Username, Group, all_of(col_names)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = all_of(col_names),
      names_to  = "Raw_Time",
      values_to = "Score"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Time = case_when(
        Raw_Time == col_names[1] ~ "T1",
        Raw_Time == col_names[2] ~ "T2",
        Raw_Time == col_names[3] ~ "T3",
        Raw_Time == col_names[4] ~ "T4"
      ),
      Username = as.factor(Username),
      Group    = droplevels(as.factor(Group)),
      Time     = factor(Time, levels = c("T1","T2","T3","T4"))
    )
  
  # ── 3a. Descriptive statistics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  desc <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(Group, Time) %>%
    summarise(
      n    = n(),
      M    = round(mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      SD   = round(sd(Score,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      SE   = round(SD / sqrt(n), 3),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write_sheet(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Descriptives"), as.data.frame(desc))
  
  cat("\n======================================================\n")
  cat("Variable: [", prefix, "]\n")
  cat("Valid sample size N =", length(unique(df_clean$Username)), "\n")
  cat("======================================================\n")
  cat("\n>>> Descriptive statistics (Group x Time)\n")
  print(as.data.frame(desc))
  print(as.data.frame(desc))
  
  # ── 3b. Mixed ANOVA ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  res_anova <- anova_test(
    data    = df_clean,
    dv      = Score,
    wid     = Username,
    between = Group,
    within  = Time,
    effect.size = "pes"
  )
  
  anova_table <- get_anova_table(res_anova) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  write_sheet(wb, paste0(prefix, "_MixedANOVA"), anova_table)
  
  cat("\n>>> Mixed ANOVA results (with partial eta squared)\n")
  print(anova_table)
  
  # -- 3c. Sphericity test ---------------------------------------------
  cat("\n>>> Mauchly's Test for Sphericity\n")
  if ("Mauchly's Test for Sphericity" %in% names(res_anova)) {
    mauchly_df <- as.data.frame(res_anova[["Mauchly's Test for Sphericity"]])
    print(mauchly_df)
    
    sheet_name    <- substr(paste0(prefix, "_MixedANOVA"), 1, 31)
    existing_rows <- nrow(anova_table) + 2
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name,
              x = data.frame(Note = "Mauchly's Test for Sphericity"),
              startRow = existing_rows + 2)
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name,
              x = mauchly_df,
              startRow = existing_rows + 3)
    cat("  Note: If p < .05, sphericity is violated; Greenhouse-Geisser correction is applied automatically.\n")
  } else {
    cat("  (No sphericity test result detected; degrees of freedom may be 1.)\n")
  }
  
  return(invisible(df_clean))
}

# -- 4. Time point suffixes --------------------------------------------
suffixes_standard <- c("task2","task4","task6","task7")

# -- 5. Run mixed ANOVA in batch ---------------------------------------
standard_vars   <- c("ICL","GCL","ECL","Kn","Ob","Pr","Mo","Ev")
clean_data_list <- list()

for (var in standard_vars) {
  clean_data_list[[var]] <- run_mixed_anova(data, var, suffixes_standard)
}
```

## Part 2
```{r}
# =====================================================================
# Part 2: Interaction NOT significant -- pairwise comparisons of time
# =====================================================================
vars_no_int <- c("GCL","ECL","Kn","Pr","Mo")

all_no_int_pwc <- list()

for (var in vars_no_int) {
  cat("\n======================================================\n")
  cat("[No interaction] [", var, "] - Pairwise comparisons of time main effect (BH correction, 6 pairs)\n")
  cat("======================================================\n")
  
  df <- clean_data_list[[var]]
  
  pwc_time <- df %>%
    pairwise_t_test(
      Score ~ Time,
      paired          = TRUE,
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    )
  
  result_df <- as.data.frame(pwc_time %>%
    dplyr::select(group1, group2, statistic, df, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif))
  
  result_df <- cbind(Variable = var, result_df)
  all_no_int_pwc[[var]] <- result_df
  
  print(result_df)
}

all_no_int_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_no_int_pwc)
write_sheet(wb, "NoInt_Time_Pairwise", all_no_int_combined)


# =====================================================================
# Part 3: Interaction significant -- simple main effects analysis
# =====================================================================
vars_int <- c("ICL","Ob","Ev")

all_sme_group_list <- list()
all_sme_time_list  <- list()

for (var in vars_int) {
  cat("\n======================================================\n")
  cat("[Significant interaction] [", var, "] - Simple main effects analysis\n")
  cat("======================================================\n")
  
  df <- clean_data_list[[var]]
  n_time  <- 4
  n_group <- length(unique(df$Group))
  
  # -- Perspective A: fix time, examine group differences --------------
  cat("\n---> Perspective A: Group differences at each time point\n")
  
  sme_group <- df %>%
    group_by(Time) %>%
    anova_test(dv = Score, wid = Username, between = Group,
               effect.size = "pes") %>%
    get_anova_table() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj        = p.adjust(p, method = "BH", n = n_time),
      p.adj.signif = case_when(
        p.adj < .001 ~ "***",
        p.adj < .01  ~ "**",
        p.adj < .05  ~ "*",
        TRUE         ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  
  all_sme_group_list[[var]] <- cbind(Variable = var, sme_group)
  print(as.data.frame(sme_group))
  
  # -- Perspective B: fix group, examine time changes ------------------
  cat("\n---> Perspective B: Time changes within each group\n")
  
  sme_time <- df %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    anova_test(dv = Score, wid = Username, within = Time,
               effect.size = "pes") %>%
    get_anova_table() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj        = p.adjust(p, method = "BH", n = n_group),
      p.adj.signif = case_when(
        p.adj < .001 ~ "***",
        p.adj < .01  ~ "**",
        p.adj < .05  ~ "*",
        TRUE         ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  
  all_sme_time_list[[var]] <- cbind(Variable = var, sme_time)
  print(as.data.frame(sme_time))
}

all_sme_group_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_sme_group_list)
all_sme_time_combined  <- do.call(rbind, all_sme_time_list)
write_sheet(wb, "Int_SME_Group", all_sme_group_combined)
write_sheet(wb, "Int_SME_Time",  all_sme_time_combined)


# =====================================================================
# Part 4: Detailed pairwise comparisons (significant interaction)
# =====================================================================
all_pwc_group_list <- list()
all_pwc_time_list  <- list()

for (var in vars_int) {
  cat("\n======================================================\n")
  cat("[Significant interaction] [", var, "] - Detailed pairwise comparisons\n")
  cat("======================================================\n")
  
  df <- clean_data_list[[var]]
  
  # -- Perspective A: fix time point, pairwise group comparisons -------
  cat("\n---> Perspective A: Pairwise group comparisons within each time point\n")
  
  pwc_group <- df %>%
    group_by(Time) %>%
    pairwise_t_test(
      Score ~ Group,
      paired          = FALSE,
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  cols_A_all <- intersect(
    c("Time", "group1", "group2", "n1", "n2", "statistic", "df", "p", "p.adj", "p.adj.signif"),
    colnames(pwc_group)
  )
  
  all_pwc_group_list[[var]] <- cbind(Variable = var, pwc_group[, cols_A_all])
  
  cat("  [All results]\n")
  print(pwc_group[, cols_A_all])
  cat("  [Significant results only (p.adj < .05)]\n")
  sig_A <- pwc_group %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)
  if (nrow(sig_A) > 0) {
    cols_A_sig <- intersect(
      c("Time", "group1", "group2", "statistic", "df", "p", "p.adj", "p.adj.signif"),
      colnames(sig_A)
    )
    print(sig_A[, cols_A_sig])
  } else {
    cat("  (No significant group differences after BH correction)\n")
  }
  
  # -- Perspective B: fix group, pairwise time point comparisons -------
  cat("\n---> Perspective B: Pairwise time point comparisons within each group\n")
  
  pwc_time <- df %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    pairwise_t_test(
      Score ~ Time,
      paired          = TRUE,
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  cols_B_all <- intersect(
    c("Group", "group1", "group2", "n1", "n2", "statistic", "df", "p", "p.adj", "p.adj.signif"),
    colnames(pwc_time)
  )
  
  all_pwc_time_list[[var]] <- cbind(Variable = var, pwc_time[, cols_B_all])
  
  cat("  [All results]\n")
  print(pwc_time[, cols_B_all])
  cat("  [Significant results only (p.adj < .05)]\n")
  sig_B <- pwc_time %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)
  if (nrow(sig_B) > 0) {
    cols_B_sig <- intersect(
      c("Group", "group1", "group2", "statistic", "df", "p", "p.adj", "p.adj.signif"),
      colnames(sig_B)
    )
    print(sig_B[, cols_B_sig])
  } else {
    cat("  (No significant time point differences after BH correction)\n")
  }
}

all_pwc_group_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_pwc_group_list)
all_pwc_time_combined  <- do.call(rbind, all_pwc_time_list)
write_sheet(wb, "Int_Pairwise_Group", all_pwc_group_combined)
write_sheet(wb, "Int_Pairwise_Time",  all_pwc_time_combined)


# =====================================================================
# Save Excel file
# =====================================================================
saveWorkbook(wb, "Mixed_ANOVA_Results_Summary.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\n\n✅ Excel file saved: Mixed_ANOVA_Results_Summary.xlsx\n")
cat("Sheets included:\n")
cat(paste(" -", names(wb)), sep = "\n")

```


# Draw pictures
```{r}
library(showtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)          

font_add(
  family     = "Arial",
  regular    = "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf",
  bold       = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold.ttf",
  italic     = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Italic.ttf",
  bolditalic = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold Italic.ttf"
)
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 600)

draw_order <- c("cn", "ai", "sf", "sf-ai", "ai-sf", "ai+sf")

layer_colors <- c(
  "cn"    = "#3AA66E",
  "ai"    = "#AA2B46",
  "sf"    = "#4A90C4",
  "sf-ai" = "#3B5DA3",
  "ai-sf" = "#E58760",
  "ai+sf" = "#D4B84A"
)

facet_labels <- c(
  "cn"    = "CN",
  "ai"    = "ASST",
  "sf"    = "SF",
  "sf-ai" = "SF-ASST",
  "ai-sf" = "ASST-SF",
  "ai+sf" = "SF+ASST"
)

base_pt <- 8

y_breaks_ICL <- seq(9.0,  14.0, by = 1.0); y_lower_ICL <- 9.0;  y_upper_ICL <- 14.0
y_breaks_Ob  <- seq(17.0, 22.0, by = 1.0); y_lower_Ob  <- 17.0; y_upper_Ob  <- 22.0
y_breaks_Ev  <- seq(17.0, 22.0, by = 1.0); y_lower_Ev  <- 17.0; y_upper_Ev  <- 22.0

y_breaks_cog  <- seq(9.0,  16.5, by = 1.0); y_lower_cog  <- 9.0;  y_upper_cog  <- 16.5
y_breaks_meta <- seq(10.0, 22.0, by = 2.0); y_lower_meta <- 10.0; y_upper_meta <- 22.0


make_panel <- function(var_name, y_label,
                       sig_df   = NULL,
                       y_breaks = NULL,
                       y_lower  = NULL,
                       y_upper  = NULL,
                       y_pad_top = 0.3) {

  df_var <- clean_data_list[[var_name]] %>%
    mutate(
      Group    = factor(Group, levels = draw_order),
      Time_num = as.numeric(gsub("T", "", as.character(Time)))
    )

  desc <- df_var %>%
    group_by(Group, Time_num) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean  = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE    = sd(Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      CI_lo = Mean - qt(0.975, n() - 1) * SE,
      CI_hi = Mean + qt(0.975, n() - 1) * SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Group       = factor(Group, levels = draw_order),
      facet_label = factor(
        facet_labels[as.character(Group)],
        levels = facet_labels[draw_order]
      )
    )

  y_upper_data <- max(desc$CI_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(y_lower))  y_lower  <- min(desc$CI_lo, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.3
  if (is.null(y_breaks)) y_breaks <- pretty(c(y_lower, y_upper_data + 1), n = 5)
  if (is.null(y_upper))  y_upper  <- y_upper_data + y_pad_top

  y_range <- y_upper - y_lower

  has_sig <- !is.null(sig_df) && nrow(sig_df) > 0

  if (has_sig) {
    sig_df <- sig_df %>%
      mutate(
        Group = factor(Group, levels = draw_order),
        span  = x2 - x1
      ) %>%
      group_by(Group) %>%
      arrange(desc(span), x1, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        y_pos = y_upper - y_range * 0.07 * rank,
        facet_label = factor(
          facet_labels[as.character(Group)],
          levels = facet_labels[draw_order]
        )
      )
  }

  all_facets <- desc %>% select(facet_label) %>% distinct()
  all_bg     <- desc %>%
    select(Group_bg = Group, Time_num, Mean, facet_label_bg = facet_label)
  bg_lines <- crossing(all_facets, all_bg) %>%
    filter(as.character(facet_label) != as.character(facet_label_bg))

  p <- ggplot(desc, aes(x = Time_num, y = Mean)) +
    geom_line(
      data = bg_lines,
      aes(x = Time_num, y = Mean, group = Group_bg),
      color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = CI_lo, ymax = CI_hi, color = Group),
      width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_line(aes(color = Group, group = Group), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Group), size = 2.2, shape = 21,
               fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ facet_label, nrow = 1, ncol = 6, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = layer_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = paste0("P", 1:4),
                       expand = c(0.08, 0.08)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks,
                       limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
                       oob    = scales::squish) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_pt, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      axis.title.y       = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial",
                                        color = "black", angle = 90,
                                        margin = margin(r = 3)),
      axis.title.x       = element_blank(),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = base_pt - 1, family = "Arial",
                                        color = "black"),
      axis.line          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray92", linetype = "dotted",
                                        linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text         = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial",
                                        color = "black", face = "bold",
                                        hjust = 0.5),
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      plot.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4, "pt")
    )

  if (has_sig) {
    tick_len <- y_range * 0.012
    text_off <- y_range * 0.006
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(data = sig_df,
        aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
        color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_segment(data = sig_df,
        aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos - tick_len, yend = y_pos),
        color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_segment(data = sig_df,
        aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos - tick_len, yend = y_pos),
        color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = sig_df,
        aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y_pos + text_off, label = label),
        size = 1.8, family = "Arial", vjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  return(p)
}


sig_ICL <- tribble(
  ~Group,   ~x1, ~x2, ~label,
  "ai+sf",    1,   4,  "*",
  "sf",       1,   4,  "*",
  "sf",       2,   4,  "***",
  "sf",       3,   4,  "*",
  "sf-ai",    2,   3,  "**",
  "sf-ai",    2,   4,  "***"
)

sig_Ob <- tribble(
  ~Group,  ~x1, ~x2, ~label,
  "cn",      1,   2,  "*",
  "cn",      1,   3,  "**",
  "cn",      1,   4,  "**"
)

sig_Ev <- tribble(
  ~Group,   ~x1, ~x2, ~label,
  "sf-ai",    2,   3,  "*",
  "sf-ai",    2,   4,  "*"
)


p_a <- make_panel("ICL", "Intrinsic Cognitive Load", sig_ICL, y_breaks_ICL, y_lower_ICL, y_upper_ICL)
p_b <- make_panel("Ob",  "Objectives",  sig_Ob,  y_breaks_Ob,  y_lower_Ob,  y_upper_Ob)
p_c <- make_panel("Ev",  "Evaluation",  sig_Ev,  y_breaks_Ev,  y_lower_Ev,  y_upper_Ev)

fig_combined <- (p_a / p_b / p_c) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "**",     
    tag_suffix = "**"      
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_markdown(  
      size   = base_pt + 2,
      family = "Arial",
      hjust  = 0,
      vjust  = 1
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 4, b = 2, l = 4, unit = "pt")
  )

ggsave("Fig_ICL_Ob_Ev.png",
       plot   = fig_combined,
       width  = 183 / 25.4,
       height = 170 / 25.4,
       dpi    = 600, units = "in")
ggsave("Fig_ICL_Ob_Ev.pdf",
       plot   = fig_combined,
       width  = 183 / 25.4,
       height = 170 / 25.4,
       device = "pdf", units = "in")
cat("Saved：Fig_ICL_Ob_Ev.png / .pdf\n")


```
